original_claim: Permission pattern rules are only defense-in-depth and do not replace OS/container/egress controls.
current_evidence: This is a sound scope limitation: pattern matching is not full command sandboxing; official Kilo docs say last matching rule wins. Runtime/sandbox enforcement itself remains untested here.
